name: Cotality
description:
Cotality's MCP server gives access to property data and analytics across real estate, mortgage, lending, appraisal, and so many more workflows. Available intelligence continues to expand. 
There is a lot you can accomplish with Cotality’s MCP server. Look up ownership and property characteristics for specific addresses, pull climate risk scores for a portfolio, check home price trends and forecasts for a given market — all here in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cotality to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cotality to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cotality.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cotality MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cotality provides these MCP tools: at-fetchClimateRiskByClip, at-fetchPropertyAnalyticsByClip, at-fetchRoofAgeByClip, clip-findPropertyByAddress, clip-findPropertyByClip, pd-fetchPropertyCharacteristicsByClip, pr-fetchHomePriceIndex, pr-fetchHomePriceIndexForecast, pr-fetchPropertyListingTrends, pr-fetchPropertyMarketTrends, and pr-fetchPropertyRentalTrends.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cotality?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cotality in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Cotality requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cotality is developed by Cotality. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
